description: 81-state Vimshottari dasha conditional probability table. For each (mahadasha_lord, antardasha_lord) pair, specifies P(domain_state | dasha_state) for all 5 domains. States: ELEVATED(E), NORMAL(N), SUPPRESSED(S). Each domain row sums to 1.0. Initial values from classical Jyotish + LL.5 axis-weight modulation. All fitted_values are null (M5-D target).
ll5_source: ll5_dasha_transit_v1_0.json — dasha_weight HIGH tier: 2 signals; MED: 12 signals; dasha_dominant: 259/380 signals
n1_disclaimer: All initial values are classical priors at n=1. UNFITTED — M5-D fitting required.
antardasha_modulation_rule: When MD==AD lord: multiply P(ELEVATED) by 1.1, renormalize. When AD lord is traditional adversary of MD lord (e.g., Sun-Saturn, Mars-Mercury), reduce P(ELEVATED) by 0.05, renormalize.
derivation: CF.M5C.2 — prior_alpha arrays added to each domain sub-object per PRIOR_SPEC §7.2. Format: prior_alpha=[alpha_E, alpha_N, alpha_S] — Dirichlet prior for P(domain_state | MD_lord). Prior is MD-lord-dependent (same for all AD within same MD). initial_values (E/N/S) retained from scaffold (classical antardasha-modulated values). antardasha modulation factors (×1.1 same-lord; ×0.85 adversary) are FIXED rules already baked into scaffold initial_values — not modified by the Dirichlet prior.
fit_method: Bayesian conjugate (Dirichlet) — hard E-step; posteriors at MD level; 23 training periods
note_ketu_venus_sun_moon_mars_rahu: These MDs have no training-period observations (future or pre-1984 periods). Their 'posteriors' equal the priors (no update). Ketu/Venus/Sun MDs in training data appear only as ADashas within Jupiter/Saturn/Mercury MDs. MD-level posterior requires MD to be active — only Jupiter (DSH.V.001-005), Saturn (DSH.V.006-014), Mercury (DSH.V.015-023) have training-period observations.
